newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela's foreign reserves rise to $15.726 bln.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela's foreign reserves rise to $15.726 bln.

text.p: Venezuela's foreign reserves rose $51 million, or 0.3 percent, to $15.726 billion in the week to February 24, according to figures released by the Central Bank Monday.
Reserves were up from $15.675 billion on February 17, the bank's latest weekly bulletin of indicators showed.
Since the start of the year, reserve levels have risen $547 million, or 3.6 percent.
The reserve figure release was delayed from its usual Friday announcement.
Reserves rose $5.5 billion, or 57 percent, last year to $15.179 billion and government officials have forecast they will grow to $20 billion by the end of 1997.
